title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources
description: Computer-use agent papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools as they pass source review, newest review first. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are not included.

items.title: Agent Zero
items.content_text: Open-source agent with its own sandboxed Linux workspace that researches, writes code and works with documents using a terminal, a browser and desktop apps.
items.summary: Open-source agent with its own sandboxed Linux workspace that researches, writes code and works with documents using a terminal, a browser and desktop apps.

items.title: AIOS
items.content_text: AIOS is an agent operating system whose computer-use architecture provides a virtual machine controller and MCP server for agents interacting with graphical computer environments.
items.summary: AIOS is an agent operating system whose computer-use architecture provides a virtual machine controller and MCP server for agents interacting with graphical computer environments.

items.title: Alumnium
items.content_text: An AI-native end-to-end testing library and MCP that lets agents interact with applications through automation drivers and verify assertions.
items.summary: An AI-native end-to-end testing library and MCP that lets agents interact with applications through automation drivers and verify assertions.

items.title: Browser Control MCP
items.content_text: An MCP server and Firefox extension that let AI assistants manage tabs, search browser history, read webpage text, and capture screenshots with user consent.
items.summary: An MCP server and Firefox extension that let AI assistants manage tabs, search browser history, read webpage text, and capture screenshots with user consent.

items.title: BrowserGPT
items.content_text: BrowserGPT is a browser automation script that uses GPT-4 to generate Playwright code for navigating and interacting with web pages from natural-language tasks.
items.summary: BrowserGPT is a browser automation script that uses GPT-4 to generate Playwright code for navigating and interacting with web pages from natural-language tasks.

items.title: Capybara
items.content_text: Capybara is a web application acceptance testing framework that simulates user interactions through browser and headless drivers.
items.summary: Capybara is a web application acceptance testing framework that simulates user interactions through browser and headless drivers.

items.title: chromedp
items.content_text: A Go package for driving browsers through the Chrome DevTools Protocol, with actions for navigating pages, interacting with elements, and reading page content.
items.summary: A Go package for driving browsers through the Chrome DevTools Protocol, with actions for navigating pages, interacting with elements, and reading page content.

items.title: CodeceptJS
items.content_text: CodeceptJS is an end-to-end testing framework that expresses browser and mobile interactions as user-facing steps through helpers such as Playwright, WebDriver, and Appium.
items.summary: CodeceptJS is an end-to-end testing framework that expresses browser and mobile interactions as user-facing steps through helpers such as Playwright, WebDriver, and Appium.

items.title: ConnectOnion
items.content_text: ConnectOnion is a CLI and Python framework that gives agents commands for connected accounts, a logged-in browser, files, and chat apps.
items.summary: ConnectOnion is a CLI and Python framework that gives agents commands for connected accounts, a logged-in browser, files, and chat apps.

items.title: Firecrawl
items.content_text: Firecrawl is an API that lets agents search and scrape web pages, then interact with pages through prompts or code.
items.summary: Firecrawl is an API that lets agents search and scrape web pages, then interact with pages through prompts or code.

items.title: Gobii Platform
items.content_text: Self-hostable platform for always-on agents based on browser-use, adding headed browsers, persistent profiles, proxy-aware routing, schedules and event triggers.
items.summary: Self-hostable platform for always-on agents based on browser-use, adding headed browsers, persistent profiles, proxy-aware routing, schedules and event triggers.

items.title: Libretto
items.content_text: Libretto is a toolkit that gives coding agents a live browser and CLI to inspect pages, record user actions, build scripts, and debug web integrations.
items.summary: Libretto is a toolkit that gives coding agents a live browser and CLI to inspect pages, record user actions, build scripts, and debug web integrations.

items.title: mcp-server-browser-use
items.content_text: MCP server that wraps browser-use so that an MCP client can automate a real browser, with a CLI, a web dashboard and a deep research mode.
items.summary: MCP server that wraps browser-use so that an MCP client can automate a real browser, with a CLI, a web dashboard and a deep research mode.

items.title: OpenManus
items.content_text: OpenManus is an open-source agent framework that runs tasks from a terminal and integrates browser execution and screenshots through Browser Use.
items.summary: OpenManus is an open-source agent framework that runs tasks from a terminal and integrates browser execution and screenshots through Browser Use.

items.title: PhantomJS
items.content_text: PhantomJS is a scriptable headless WebKit tool for automating web pages, capturing page contents, testing, and monitoring network activity.
items.summary: PhantomJS is a scriptable headless WebKit tool for automating web pages, capturing page contents, testing, and monitoring network activity.

items.title: pi-computer-use
items.content_text: Pi extension that gives agents tools to find app windows, observe and search visible controls, click, type, scroll and wait for UI changes in desktop software.
items.summary: Pi extension that gives agents tools to find app windows, observe and search visible controls, click, type, scroll and wait for UI changes in desktop software.

items.title: Playwright MCP Server (ExecuteAutomation)
items.content_text: Community MCP server that gives LLMs Playwright browser automation for interacting with web pages, taking screenshots, generating test code and running JavaScript.
items.summary: Community MCP server that gives LLMs Playwright browser automation for interacting with web pages, taking screenshots, generating test code and running JavaScript.

items.title: puppeteer-extra
items.content_text: A modular plugin framework for Puppeteer, maintained in a monorepo with plugins and related packages.
items.summary: A modular plugin framework for Puppeteer, maintained in a monorepo with plugins and related packages.

items.title: Qwen Code
items.content_text: Qwen Code is an open-source coding agent that supports desktop automation through computer-use tools alongside terminal, editor, web, and chat interfaces.
items.summary: Qwen Code is an open-source coding agent that supports desktop automation through computer-use tools alongside terminal, editor, web, and chat interfaces.

items.title: SeleniumBase
items.content_text: Python browser automation framework for web crawling, end-to-end testing and scraping, with a recorder that generates tests and stealth options.
items.summary: Python browser automation framework for web crawling, end-to-end testing and scraping, with a recorder that generates tests and stealth options.

items.title: Tactile
items.content_text: Skill, protocol and tool layer that has agents operate software through accessibility semantics first, reading roles, names and states before reaching for screenshots.
items.summary: Skill, protocol and tool layer that has agents operate software through accessibility semantics first, reading roles, names and states before reaching for screenshots.

items.title: TestDriver SDK
items.content_text: Vitest plugin that spawns ephemeral devices and uses vision-based LLMs to build end-to-end tests of web apps, desktop apps and browser extensions.
items.summary: Vitest plugin that spawns ephemeral devices and uses vision-based LLMs to build end-to-end tests of web apps, desktop apps and browser extensions.

items.title: TestZeus Hercules
items.content_text: Open-source testing agent that takes Gherkin features and executes them end to end on web applications through Playwright.
items.summary: Open-source testing agent that takes Gherkin features and executes them end to end on web applications through Playwright.

items.title: web-eval-agent
items.content_text: MCP server that launches a browser-use agent to run a web app, capture screenshots, console and network logs, and return a UX report to the coding agent.
items.summary: MCP server that launches a browser-use agent to run a web app, capture screenshots, console and network logs, and return a UX report to the coding agent.

items.title: "What Did It Actually Do?": Understanding Risk Awareness and Traceability for Computer-Use Agents
items.content_text: Presents an interview study of computer-use agent risks and AgentTrace, a prototype interface showing agent actions, resource access, permission history, and lasting changes.
items.summary: Presents an interview study of computer-use agent risks and AgentTrace, a prototype interface showing agent actions, resource access, permission history, and lasting changes.

items.title: A Benchmark and Framework for Evaluating Next Action Predictions in Spreadsheets
items.content_text: Introduces a benchmark and online evaluation method for predicting the next spreadsheet action from a user's action history, using curated action sequences.
items.summary: Introduces a benchmark and online evaluation method for predicting the next spreadsheet action from a user's action history, using curated action sequences.

items.title: A Decade in a Day: Synthesizing Agent-Native Interfaces from Human-Oriented Software Evolution
items.content_text: Introduces DeskIF-Bench to study how desktop application interfaces affect agents, and ANIS to synthesize interfaces from installed application capabilities.
items.summary: Introduces DeskIF-Bench to study how desktop application interfaces affect agents, and ANIS to synthesize interfaces from installed application capabilities.

items.title: A Task-State Representation for Long-Horizon Mobile GUI Agents
items.content_text: Introduces TSR, a training-free wrapper for long-horizon mobile GUI agents that tracks instructions, subgoal progress, and action outcomes separately from screen observations.
items.summary: Introduces TSR, a training-free wrapper for long-horizon mobile GUI agents that tracks instructions, subgoal progress, and action outcomes separately from screen observations.

items.title: AcademiClaw: When Students Set Challenges for AI Agents
items.content_text: AcademiClaw benchmarks OpenClaw agents on long academic workflows, scoring task completion in isolated Docker sandboxes with rubrics and a safety audit.
items.summary: AcademiClaw benchmarks OpenClaw agents on long academic workflows, scoring task completion in isolated Docker sandboxes with rubrics and a safety audit.

items.title: Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay
items.content_text: Introduces Activity Frames, a deterministic pipeline that turns captured screen activity into typed episodes for computer-use agent memory and routine replay.
items.summary: Introduces Activity Frames, a deterministic pipeline that turns captured screen activity into typed episodes for computer-use agent memory and routine replay.

items.title: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
items.content_text: Introduces AdaGround, a training-free GUI grounding method that adjusts screenshot zoom to target size and uses a click verifier to refine or reject predictions.
items.summary: Introduces AdaGround, a training-free GUI grounding method that adjusts screenshot zoom to target size and uses a click verifier to refine or reject predictions.

items.title: Affora: A Design System for Agent-Friendly Interfaces
items.content_text: Presents Affora, a design system with reusable components and executable checks for interfaces used by computer-use agents, informed by studies of components and visual variation.
items.summary: Presents Affora, a design system with reusable components and executable checks for interfaces used by computer-use agents, informed by studies of components and visual variation.

items.title: Agent MechSuits: Mechanistic Subspace Safety Steering for Multi-Turn CLI Agents
items.content_text: Introduces Agent MechSuits, a framework that detects unsafe states and steers multi-turn CLI agents through hidden-representation interventions, alongside the MAS trajectory benchmark.
items.summary: Introduces Agent MechSuits, a framework that detects unsafe states and steers multi-turn CLI agents through hidden-representation interventions, alongside the MAS trajectory benchmark.

items.title: AgentHazard: A Benchmark for Evaluating Harmful Behavior in Computer-Use Agents
items.content_text: Introduces AgentHazard, a benchmark of harmful multi-step behavior by computer-use agents acting through tools, files, and execution environments.
items.summary: Introduces AgentHazard, a benchmark of harmful multi-step behavior by computer-use agents acting through tools, files, and execution environments.

items.title: AgentHeal: Evaluating Goal-Preserving Resource Recovery of Web Agents under Access Barriers
items.content_text: Introduces AgentHeal, a benchmark of whether web agents detect access barriers, find legitimate alternative sources, and preserve the user's original goal.
items.summary: Introduces AgentHeal, a benchmark of whether web agents detect access barriers, find legitimate alternative sources, and preserve the user's original goal.

items.title: AgentHijack: Benchmarking Computer Use Agent Robustness to Common Environment Corruptions
items.content_text: Introduces AgentHijack, a benchmark for desktop computer-use agents facing pop-ups, resolution changes and other common corruptions, alongside an agent that checks its environment.
items.summary: Introduces AgentHijack, a benchmark for desktop computer-use agents facing pop-ups, resolution changes and other common corruptions, alongside an agent that checks its environment.

items.title: Agentic Compilation: Mitigating the LLM Rerun Crisis for Minimized-Inference-Cost Web Automation
items.content_text: Proposes Compile-and-Execute, which turns a sanitized DOM into a reusable JSON workflow so repetitive browser tasks can run without further model queries.
items.summary: Proposes Compile-and-Execute, which turns a sanitized DOM into a reusable JSON workflow so repetitive browser tasks can run without further model queries.

items.title: Agentic Critical Training
items.content_text: Introduces Agentic Critical Training (ACT), a reinforcement-learning warm-up that teaches general agents to choose expert actions over alternatives, with WebShop among its evaluations.
items.summary: Introduces Agentic Critical Training (ACT), a reinforcement-learning warm-up that teaches general agents to choose expert actions over alternatives, with WebShop among its evaluations.

items.title: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements
items.content_text: Introduces Agentic ESOpt, an evolution-strategies fine-tuning framework for long-horizon agents, evaluated on WebArena-Lite web tasks and automatic heuristic design.
items.summary: Introduces Agentic ESOpt, an evolution-strategies fine-tuning framework for long-horizon agents, evaluated on WebArena-Lite web tasks and automatic heuristic design.

items.title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
items.content_text: Survey of agentic world models that classifies predictive capabilities and governing laws, including the digital setting of web and GUI agents.
items.summary: Survey of agentic world models that classifies predictive capabilities and governing laws, including the digital setting of web and GUI agents.

items.title: AgentLens: Adaptive Visual Modalities for Human-Agent Interaction in Mobile GUI Agents
items.content_text: Introduces AgentLens, a mobile GUI agent that shows full, partial, or generated interface views during background task execution to support user interaction.
items.summary: Introduces AgentLens, a mobile GUI agent that shows full, partial, or generated interface views during background task execution to support user interaction.

items.title: AgentOS: From Application Silos to a Natural Language-Driven Data Ecosystem
items.content_text: Proposes Personal Agent Operating System (AgentOS), with a natural language or voice portal and an Agent Kernel that coordinates agents and tasks in place of a GUI desktop.
items.summary: Proposes Personal Agent Operating System (AgentOS), with a natural language or voice portal and an Agent Kernel that coordinates agents and tasks in place of a GUI desktop.

items.title: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
items.content_text: Introduces AgentProofBench, a benchmark linking tests of reusable web-agent verification rules to subsequent execution from saved web states.
items.summary: Introduces AgentProofBench, a benchmark linking tests of reusable web-agent verification rules to subsequent execution from saved web states.

items.title: AgentShield: Fortifying Web Applications Against AI Agents and Agentic Browsers
items.content_text: Evaluates agentic browsers against web anti-bot defenses and introduces AgentShield, a behavioral fingerprinting framework for distinguishing agents from people.
items.summary: Evaluates agentic browsers against web anti-bot defenses and introduces AgentShield, a behavioral fingerprinting framework for distinguishing agents from people.

items.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
items.content_text: AgentVQA is an offline visual question-answering benchmark across five agent domains, including web agents and questions involving UI element location.
items.summary: AgentVQA is an offline visual question-answering benchmark across five agent domains, including web agents and questions involving UI element location.

items.title: AI Planning Framework for LLM-Based Web Agents
items.content_text: Introduces a planning taxonomy and trajectory-quality metrics for web agents, supported by 794 human-labeled WebArena trajectories and a comparison of two planning styles.
items.summary: Introduces a planning taxonomy and trajectory-quality metrics for web agents, supported by 794 human-labeled WebArena trajectories and a comparison of two planning styles.

items.title: Alignment Is Local: A Paired Diagnostic for GUI Agents under User-Side Persuasion
items.content_text: Presents a paired diagnostic of prompt guardrails in GUI agents under screen-grounded user persuasion, comparing single-turn probes with four-turn escalation.
items.summary: Presents a paired diagnostic of prompt guardrails in GUI agents under screen-grounded user persuasion, comparing single-turn probes with four-turn escalation.

items.title: Anchor: Preventing Artifact Drift for Reliable Agent Verification
items.content_text: Anchor builds ERP-Bench by generating procurement and manufacturing tasks with shared state verifiers for evaluating browser and computer-use agents.
items.summary: Anchor builds ERP-Bench by generating procurement and manufacturing tasks with shared state verifiers for evaluating browser and computer-use agents.

items.title: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
items.content_text: Introduces AndroidFlux, a mobile-agent failure-recovery benchmark that restores trajectories to error checkpoints, plus a reward-modeling benchmark and offline RL dataset.
items.summary: Introduces AndroidFlux, a mobile-agent failure-recovery benchmark that restores trajectories to error checkpoints, plus a reward-modeling benchmark and offline RL dataset.

items.title: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
items.content_text: Introduces REEF, a website benchmark with state-based attack verification, and ANGLER, which adapts attack lures using outcomes from web-agent rollouts.
items.summary: Introduces REEF, a website benchmark with state-based attack verification, and ANGLER, which adapts attack lures using outcomes from web-agent rollouts.

items.title: AOHP: An Open-Source OS-Level Agent Harness for Personalized, Efficient and Secure Interaction
items.content_text: Introduces AOHP, an Android OS-level harness that treats agents as system actors and provides adaptive interfaces, agent interfaces, and information-flow controls.
items.summary: Introduces AOHP, an Android OS-level harness that treats agents as system actors and provides adaptive interfaces, agent interfaces, and information-flow controls.

items.title: AppAgent-Claw: CLI Is All You Need for GUI Automation
items.content_text: Introduces AppAgent-Claw, which records demonstrated GUI workflows as reusable OpenClaw skills, locates visual targets during replay and checks intended on-screen effects.
items.summary: Introduces AppAgent-Claw, which records demonstrated GUI workflows as reusable OpenClaw skills, locates visual targets during replay and checks intended on-screen effects.

items.title: AQuaUI: Visual Token Reduction for GUI Agents with Adaptive Quadtrees
items.content_text: AQuaUI reduces screenshot tokens for GUI agents at inference time with adaptive quadtrees that retain spatial positions and reuse prior tree structure across steps.
items.summary: AQuaUI reduces screenshot tokens for GUI agents at inference time with adaptive quadtrees that retain spatial positions and reuse prior tree structure across steps.

items.title: Ares: Adaptive Reasoning Effort Selection for Efficient LLM Agents
items.content_text: Introduces Ares, a router that selects a reasoning level for each step of a general LLM agent from its interaction history, with web agents among the evaluation settings.
items.summary: Introduces Ares, a router that selects a reasoning level for each step of a general LLM agent from its interaction history, with web agents among the evaluation settings.

items.title: Augmenting Interface Usability Heuristics for Reliable Computer-Use Agents
items.content_text: A study adapts interface usability heuristics for computer-use agents and evaluates augmented designs in UI-Verse, a suite of controlled interface environments.
items.summary: A study adapts interface usability heuristics for computer-use agents and evaluates augmented designs in UI-Verse, a suite of controlled interface environments.

items.title: Automated Trajectory Evaluation for Mobile Agents via Step-Level Consequence Reasoning and Aggregation
items.content_text: Introduces CRATE, a step-level visual judge for mobile-agent trajectories, and CRATE-S for assessing operational safety from action-conditioned state changes.
items.summary: Introduces CRATE, a step-level visual judge for mobile-agent trajectories, and CRATE-S for assessing operational safety from action-conditioned state changes.

items.title: AutomationBench
items.content_text: Introduces AutomationBench, a benchmark for agents coordinating business workflows across applications through REST APIs, including endpoint discovery and policy adherence.
items.summary: Introduces AutomationBench, a benchmark for agents coordinating business workflows across applications through REST APIs, including endpoint discovery and policy adherence.

items.title: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
items.content_text: Introduces MiniWeb for skill-labeled browser tasks, MiniWebGen for generating training trajectories, and MiniWebAgent for composing learned skills into web workflows.
items.summary: Introduces MiniWeb for skill-labeled browser tasks, MiniWebGen for generating training trajectories, and MiniWebAgent for composing learned skills into web workflows.

items.title: Back to the Future: A workbook time machine for spread sheet creation benchmarks
items.content_text: Introduces the workbook time machine to create spreadsheet-object tasks and wtmbench to evaluate spreadsheet manipulation agents using different control interfaces.
items.summary: Introduces the workbook time machine to create spreadsheet-object tasks and wtmbench to evaluate spreadsheet manipulation agents using different control interfaces.

items.title: BAMI: Training-Free Bias Mitigation in GUI Grounding
items.content_text: BAMI uses coarse-to-fine focus and candidate selection at inference time to address precision and ambiguity errors in GUI grounding.
items.summary: BAMI uses coarse-to-fine focus and candidate selection at inference time to address precision and ambiguity errors in GUI grounding.

items.title: BaRA: Budget-constrained and Reliable Web Data Collection Agent
items.content_text: Introduces BaRA, a web data-collection agent that discovers live site links, checks extracted text, images, and videos, and uses history to recover from failures.
items.summary: Introduces BaRA, a web data-collection agent that discovers live site links, checks extracted text, images, and videos, and uses history to recover from failures.

items.title: Benchmarking General Mobile Assistants in Challenging Real-World Scenarios
items.content_text: Introduces GMA, a benchmark of 300 mobile-assistant tasks across seven applications, and studies how agent context retention and state tracking affect complex workflows.
items.summary: Introduces GMA, a benchmark of 300 mobile-assistant tasks across seven applications, and studies how agent context retention and state tracking affect complex workflows.

items.title: Benchmarking Web Agent Safety under E-commerce Deceptive Interfaces
items.content_text: Introduces WebDecept, a plugin for injecting deceptive e-commerce interface patterns during web-agent tasks and evaluating how multimodal agents respond.
items.summary: Introduces WebDecept, a plugin for injecting deceptive e-commerce interface patterns during web-agent tasks and evaluating how multimodal agents respond.

items.title: Beyond Binary: Reframing GUI Critique as Continuous Semantic Alignment
items.content_text: BBCritic ranks candidate GUI-agent actions through instruction–action alignment, while BBBench evaluates fine-grained ranking with a hierarchical action taxonomy.
items.summary: BBCritic ranks candidate GUI-agent actions through instruction–action alignment, while BBBench evaluates fine-grained ranking with a hierarchical action taxonomy.

items.title: Beyond Domains: Reusing Web Skills via Transferable Interaction Patterns
items.content_text: Introduces SkillMigrator, a web agent that turns successful interactions into reusable skills and transfers them between sites by matching page layouts and live element references.
items.summary: Introduces SkillMigrator, a web agent that turns successful interactions into reusable skills and transfers them between sites by matching page layouts and live element references.

items.title: Beyond the Verdict: Evidence-Aligned Evaluation of Visual Prompt-Injection Guardrails
items.content_text: Introduces Mind2Web-Injection, a benchmark for evaluating web-agent guardrail decisions on instruction-screenshot pairs using evidence boxes and image-side counterfactuals.
items.summary: Introduces Mind2Web-Injection, a benchmark for evaluating web-agent guardrail decisions on instruction-screenshot pairs using evidence boxes and image-side counterfactuals.

items.title: BlueFin: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Financial Spreadsheets
items.content_text: Introduces BlueFin, a benchmark and evaluation framework for agents handling professional finance spreadsheet workbooks through synthesis, manipulation, and comprehension tasks.
items.summary: Introduces BlueFin, a benchmark and evaluation framework for agents handling professional finance spreadsheet workbooks through synthesis, manipulation, and comprehension tasks.

items.title: BraveGuard: From Open-World Threats to Safer Computer-Use Agents
items.content_text: Introduces BraveGuard, a framework that turns emerging threats and computer-use agent trajectories into training supervision for guards that monitor multi-step safety risks.
items.summary: Introduces BraveGuard, a framework that turns emerging threats and computer-use agent trajectories into training supervision for guards that monitor multi-step safety risks.

items.title: Bridging VideoQA and Video-Guided Agentic Tasks via Generalized Keyframe Extraction
items.content_text: Introduces VG-GUIBench to evaluate GUI agents following video tutorials, and TASKER to select task-relevant keyframes for video-guided tasks and VideoQA.
items.summary: Introduces VG-GUIBench to evaluate GUI agents following video tutorials, and TASKER to select task-relevant keyframes for video-guided tasks and VideoQA.

items.title: Build or Adopt? Custom-Built vs. General-Purpose LLM Agent Harnesses for Automotive GUI Testing
items.content_text: Compares a custom harness with general-purpose LLM agent harnesses for GUI testing of Android-based vehicle interfaces and tasks in public apps.
items.summary: Compares a custom harness with general-purpose LLM agent harnesses for GUI testing of Android-based vehicle interfaces and tasks in public apps.

items.title: CA-OPD: Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Structured Visual Prediction
items.content_text: Introduces CA-OPD, a confidence-guided distillation method for visual prediction, evaluated on GUI grounding and optical character recognition benchmarks.
items.summary: Introduces CA-OPD, a confidence-guided distillation method for visual prediction, evaluated on GUI grounding and optical character recognition benchmarks.

items.title: Can LLM Agents Learn to Test? Maintaining Scoped Experience as Testing Evidence for Mobile GUI Testing
items.content_text: AdaptiTest specifies scoped, revalidated memory for an LLM-based mobile GUI tester to reuse routes and locators across read-only Android test workflows.
items.summary: AdaptiTest specifies scoped, revalidated memory for an LLM-based mobile GUI tester to reuse routes and locators across read-only Android test workflows.

items.title: CAPTCHA Solving for Native GUI Agents: Automated Reasoning-Action Data Generation and Self-Corrective Training
items.content_text: Introduces ReCAP, a native GUI agent for interactive CAPTCHA challenges, trained with generated interaction trajectories, reasoning traces and self-correction data.
items.summary: Introduces ReCAP, a native GUI agent for interactive CAPTCHA challenges, trained with generated interaction trajectories, reasoning traces and self-correction data.

items.title: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
items.content_text: Introduces Hagasu, a scrollable-region perception model that helps GUI agents decide where to swipe to reveal hidden targets, especially on mobile screens.
items.summary: Introduces Hagasu, a scrollable-region perception model that helps GUI agents decide where to swipe to reveal hidden targets, especially on mobile screens.

items.title: ChartAct: A Benchmark for Dynamic Chart Understanding
items.content_text: ChartAct benchmarks multimodal models and GUI agents on interactive charts from websites, requiring actions such as hovering or zooming to answer questions.
items.summary: ChartAct benchmarks multimodal models and GUI agents on interactive charts from websites, requiring actions such as hovering or zooming to answer questions.

items.title: ClawProBench: Trace-Aware Evaluation of AI Agents with Runtime Coverage and Frozen Workplace-Style Holdouts
items.content_text: Introduces ClawProBench, a trace-aware benchmark for agents on OpenClaw that scores workspace and native-runtime tasks using execution traces, safety checks, and process quality.
items.summary: Introduces ClawProBench, a trace-aware benchmark for agents on OpenClaw that scores workspace and native-runtime tasks using execution traces, safety checks, and process quality.

items.title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
items.content_text: Introduces Co-Design Bench to evaluate coding agents that revise applications from multimodal user requests, including UI changes assessed with browser evidence.
items.summary: Introduces Co-Design Bench to evaluate coding agents that revise applications from multimodal user requests, including UI changes assessed with browser evidence.

items.title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
items.content_text: Introduces CoPE, which trains language agents to forecast later actions from earlier histories during RL; WebShop is one of five evaluation benchmarks.
items.summary: Introduces CoPE, which trains language agents to forecast later actions from earlier histories during RL; WebShop is one of five evaluation benchmarks.

items.title: CoAdapt-GUI: Joint Workflow Context and Policy Adaptation for Unseen GUI Applications
items.content_text: Introduces CoAdapt-GUI, which adapts workflow context and policy from a mobile GUI agent's own rollouts and rewards when it encounters unseen applications.
items.summary: Introduces CoAdapt-GUI, which adapts workflow context and policy from a mobile GUI agent's own rollouts and rewards when it encounters unseen applications.

items.title: CoArena: Evaluating Computer-Use and Multi-Agent Systems in Real Time
items.content_text: Introduces CoArena, an evaluation method where user tasks run concurrently in sandboxed desktops and blind pairwise judgments update a public leaderboard.
items.summary: Introduces CoArena, an evaluation method where user tasks run concurrently in sandboxed desktops and blind pairwise judgments update a public leaderboard.

items.title: Coati: Host-Grounded Execution for Installable Mobile GUI Agents
items.content_text: Introduces Coati, an installable Android GUI agent that checks action outcomes with phone-side evidence, stores per-app procedures, and routes simpler steps to a fast executor.
items.summary: Introduces Coati, an installable Android GUI agent that checks action outcomes with phone-side evidence, stores per-app procedures, and routes simpler steps to a fast executor.

items.title: CocoaBench: Evaluating Unified Digital Agents in the Wild
items.content_text: Introduces CocoaBench, a benchmark for unified digital agents on long-horizon tasks combining vision, search, and coding, including capabilities related to GUI automation.
items.summary: Introduces CocoaBench, a benchmark for unified digital agents on long-horizon tasks combining vision, search, and coding, including capabilities related to GUI automation.

items.title: CoME: Empowering Channel-of-Mobile-Experts with Informative Hybrid-Capabilities Reasoning
items.content_text: Introduces Channel-of-Mobile-Experts (CoME), a mobile agent with experts for screen summary, subtask planning, action decisions and action functions, trained in stages with InfoGain-Driven DPO (Info-DPO).
items.summary: Introduces Channel-of-Mobile-Experts (CoME), a mobile agent with experts for screen summary, subtask planning, action decisions and action functions, trained in stages with InfoGain-Driven DPO (Info-DPO).

items.title: Computer Use at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
items.content_text: DigiWorld is a sandboxed mobile-app benchmark for computer-use agents, paired with PRISM environment principles and a confidence-interval aggregation method.
items.summary: DigiWorld is a sandboxed mobile-app benchmark for computer-use agents, paired with PRISM environment principles and a confidence-interval aggregation method.

items.title: Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials
items.content_text: RAG-PolicyJudge selects computer-use actions proposed with task-specific tutorials; the study compares its decisions with and without world-model rollouts.
items.summary: RAG-PolicyJudge selects computer-use actions proposed with task-specific tutorials; the study compares its decisions with and without world-model rollouts.

items.title: Constraining Host-Level Abuse in Self-Hosted Computer-Use Agents via TEE-Backed Isolation

items.title: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier

items.title: Cross-Interface Authorization for AI Computer-Use Agents
